Lina (CS): Heads up - Mosaic onboarding surfaced three asks that could affect renewal in ~4w. Capturing here for product triage and an enablement play.

Lina (CS): Raw asks: 1) Finance needs a monthly CSV export of per-route token usage + $cost breakdown. 2) Customers want a simple per-route embedding TTL override (dev/test shorter). 3) Onboarding flow doesn't call out KMS/service-account hookup explicitly and customers stall.

Omar (PM): Impact quick notes?

Lina (CS): 1) CSV export = high (audit/renewal). 2) TTL override = medium (cost control). 3) KMS step = high (blocks go-live).

Hyun (Eng): Feasibility: CSV = small-medium (usage aggregation + CSV endpoint). TTL override = small (route config flag). KMS onboarding fix = medium (console + docs + security review).

Omar (PM): Proposed triage: P0 = KMS onboarding messaging + checklist in modal; P1 = CSV export; P2 = TTL override. Agree?

Rae (Enablement): I can run a hands-on assist tomorrow 11am PT to walk Mosaic through the KMS steps and share a checklist. Can we add the checklist text to the modal as a short-term copy?

Hyun (Eng): I'll scope a 1.5d spike for KMS console changes and security touchpoints. Will post findings here.

Lina (CS): I'll tell Mosaic we have an enablement session and a CSV workaround (manual API snippet) while product moves the spike. They sounded relieved and will hold renewal convo until after the assist.

ops-bot: reminder: create ticket "onboarding: KMS checklist + modal" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
